lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ho2CuBiO6 crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with a 30-atom unit cell (Ho6Cu3Bi3O18) distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Cu centers coordinated by six O neighbors and Ho centers coordinated by six O neighbors, while Bi centers show a close-packed-like 12-neighbor arrangement. Corner-sharing between CuO6 and HO6 octahedra is observed, alongside face-sharing between Bi and Cu polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional geometric neighbor network.
